LanguageData.MooGirl_BunnyGirlTop.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a backless, deep-V glossy latex catsuit, complete with a snow-pompom tail.\nThe collar bow accentuates a swan-like neck, while the bust curve is presented with sculptural precision; allurement is the ultimate armour.
LanguageData.MooGirl_BunnyGirlTop.label: Mugirl Bunny Girl Top Suit
LanguageData.MooGirl_Cheongsam.description: A Mugirl silk cheongsam from "Vache Rousse", with ornate floral embroidery and a flowing white silhouette shaped by eastern aesthetics.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Cheongsam.label: Mugirl Cheongsam "Cloud-Cut Bright Moon"
LanguageData.MooGirl_Hipwrappingskirt.description: "Vache Rousse" presents a liquid-reflect pencil skirt, with a hemline twenty centimetres above the knee that hints at concealed delights.\nEach step creates a rhythmic shackle, imprisoning the gaze of onlookers.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Hipwrappingskirt.label: Mugirl Pencil Skirt "Captivité d'Obsidienne"
LanguageData.MooGirl_ImmortalFairy.description: "Vache Rousse" presents an ethereal robe of drifting gauze, its back falling open like a cascading waterfall while crimson ribbons rise and settle with each step. Golden threads of starlight glimmer along the sleeves, and a frost-silk tassel at the waist traces a willow-slender figure. The curve of the chest appears and fades like moonlit mist, as though immortal grace itself had taken shape. Its splendour is not mere display, but the natural outward flow of cultivated power, with beauty itself serving as the keenest weapon.
LanguageData.MooGirl_ImmortalFairy.label: Mugirl Fairy Raiment
LanguageData.MooGirl_OL.description: A crisp silk office lady suit from "Vache Rousse". The fitted cut extends from shoulders and neck to the skirt, drawing a capable figure with smooth lines. Understated details conceal refined design, and the light fabric flashes with a professional texture in shifting light. It is not only a dignified symbol for the workplace, but also a confident and elegant presence in any crowd.
LanguageData.MooGirl_OL.label: Mugirl Office Lady Suit
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_Unionary.description: A specialised combat uniform developed for Mugirls by the revolutionary army during the Mareko Revolutionary War.
LanguageData.MooGirl_RA_Unionary.label: Mugirl Revolutionary Combat Uniform
LanguageData.MooGirl_Uniform.description: "Vache Rousse" presents the standard Mugirl uniform: a tailored blazer paired with an ultra-short skirt that accentuates a slender figure.\nThe ten-centimetre-above-knee cut highlights the absolute territory.\nA lethal weapon in the office environment, each step treads the line between propriety and desire, awakening forbidden fantasies.
LanguageData.MooGirl_Uniform.label: Mugirl Uniform "Zone Interdite du Pouvoir"
LanguageData.MooGirl_WeddingDress.description: A floor-length silk wedding dress from "Vache Rousse". Streamlined tailoring flows down from the shoulders and neck, while layered gauze reflects a pure sheen. Clean contours shape the figure, and restrained details hide a sharp edge, letting sanctity and confidence stand together. More than the focus of a ceremony, it becomes a white presence no crowd can ignore.
LanguageData.MooGirl_WeddingDress.label: Mugirl Wedding Dress
